ios.desc:
Gotcha RSS Feed is a focused, native RSS and Atom reader for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

Follow your favorite blogs and news sources in an interface that adapts to your screen. Browse feeds, choose an article, and read at your own pace.

Features:
• Add RSS and Atom feed URLs
• Import a Newsboat-style urls file
• Save favorites with the heart button in Loved Articles
• Search your saved stories and keep cached feed content after removing a source
• Adjust reader scale from 80–200%
• Customize feed labels
• Choose Light, Dark, or System appearance
• Track new and read articles
• Refresh all feeds or individual sources
• Load linked articles or open them in your browser
• A native layout for iPhone, iPad, and Mac
• Optional iCloud sync for your feed list and feed names

No account, ads, or analytics SDKs. Cached articles, loved articles, and reading state are stored locally on each device. Optional iCloud sync keeps your feed list and feed names the same across your devices, using your private iCloud. Websites and feed providers you access operate under their own privacy policies.

quotes.text:
Hi folks!

Presenting a clean and sleek RSS Reader for MacOS, iPhone and iPad. Keeps everything offline, needs no account, does not tracking. Does everything you need your RSS reader to do and nothing more. You can use RSS or Atom feed and also bulk import a list of RSS feeds from another app.

Currently $7.99 lifetime for a month. So please give it a try and give your feedback.
